name: minington_strip_level
title: Minington repeatable strip level
coordinate_rule: x east, z south; logical y=0 is ground walking height. File-local = logical - logical_min. Default front is south; ranch gate faces east.
void_policy: structure_void means PRESERVE; air means CLEAR. Native NBT omits preserve cells. Never turn omitted cells into air.

worksite.runtime_rules: Excavate only claimed passages in order. Stop a branch at water/lava/caves. Preserve unlisted rock. Supply torches/ladders/chests; full storage pauses. Never place generic stone over ore.

provenance: Approved full prompt plus concretized roof, wall, lighting, and support details; see DESIGN-NOTES.txt.
